description: Model Context Protocol server providing tools to access VesselAPI endpoints

tool_signatures.name: get_port
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a specific port by UN/LOCODE

unlocode.description: UN/LOCODE of the port (e.g. NLRTM for Rotterdam)

parameters.name: unlocode
parameters.description: UN/LOCODE of the port (e.g. NLRTM for Rotterdam)

tool_signatures.name: get_port_events
tool_signatures.description: Get port events (arrivals/departures) for a specific port. Covers only the last 2 hours unless timeFrom is given.

timeFrom.description: Start of the time window, RFC3339. Without it the service returns only the last 2 hours.

timeTo.description: End of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: timeFrom
parameters.description: Start of the time window, RFC3339. Without it the service returns only the last 2 hours.

parameters.name: timeTo
parameters.description: End of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to now.

tool_signatures.name: get_port_events_by_vessel
tool_signatures.description: Get port events (arrivals/departures) for a specific vessel. Covers only the last 2 hours unless timeFrom is given. Events are kept for 31 days.

eventType.description: Filter by event type. Omit for both arrivals and departures

timeFrom.description: Start of the time window, RFC3339. Without it the service returns only the last 2 hours.

timeTo.description: End of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: Filter by event type. Omit for both arrivals and departures

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: timeFrom
parameters.description: Start of the time window, RFC3339. Without it the service returns only the last 2 hours.

parameters.name: timeTo
parameters.description: End of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to now.

tool_signatures.name: get_port_inbound
tool_signatures.description: Get vessels whose own reported destination is this port, with a declared ETA inside the arrival window. ETAs are reported by the vessels, not predicted.

unlocode.description: UN/LOCODE of the destination port (e.g. NLRTM for Rotterdam)

etaFrom.description: Start of ETA arrival window (RFC3339). Omit to default to now.

etaTo.description: End of ETA arrival window (RFC3339). Omit to default to 72 hours ahead.

timeFrom.description: Only use reports received after this time, RFC3339. Defaults to 24 hours ago.

timeTo.description: Only use reports received before this time, RFC3339. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: etaFrom
parameters.description: Start of ETA arrival window (RFC3339). Omit to default to now.

parameters.name: etaTo
parameters.description: End of ETA arrival window (RFC3339). Omit to default to 72 hours ahead.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: timeFrom
parameters.description: Only use reports received after this time, RFC3339. Defaults to 24 hours ago.

parameters.name: timeTo
parameters.description: Only use reports received before this time, RFC3339. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: unlocode
parameters.description: UN/LOCODE of the destination port (e.g. NLRTM for Rotterdam)

tool_signatures.name: get_vessel
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about a specific vessel

tool_signatures.name: get_vessel_casualties
tool_signatures.description: Get marine casualty records for a vessel

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

tool_signatures.name: get_vessel_emissions
tool_signatures.description: Get EU MRV annual emissions reports for a vessel (CO2, fuel consumption). Only ships that report under EU MRV have data.

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

tool_signatures.name: get_vessel_eta
tool_signatures.description: Get the most recent ETA the vessel itself reported in its AIS voyage data. This is the declared ETA, not a prediction.

tool_signatures.name: get_vessel_last_port_event
tool_signatures.description: Get the most recent port event (arrival or departure) for a vessel

tool_signatures.name: get_vessel_position
tool_signatures.description: Get the latest stored position of a vessel (latitude, longitude, speed, heading, timestamp). Check the timestamp: the fix may be hours or days old, especially for a vessel away from the coast.

sat.description: Fall back to a satellite position when no recent terrestrial one exists. Charged per call against a prepaid balance, so use it only when a stored position is genuinely insufficient.

parameters.name: sat
parameters.description: Fall back to a satellite position when no recent terrestrial one exists. Charged per call against a prepaid balance, so use it only when a stored position is genuinely insufficient.

tool_signatures.name: get_vessel_positions_batch
tool_signatures.description: Get positions for multiple vessels at once by MMSI or IMO numbers

ids.description: Comma-separated list of MMSI or IMO numbers

timeFrom.description: Start time filter in RFC3339 format (defaults to 2 hours ago)

timeTo.description: End time filter in RFC3339 format (defaults to current time)

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of MMSI or IMO numbers

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: timeFrom
parameters.description: Start time filter in RFC3339 format (defaults to 2 hours ago)

parameters.name: timeTo
parameters.description: End time filter in RFC3339 format (defaults to current time)

tool_signatures.name: get_vessels_in_area
tool_signatures.description: Find vessels with an AIS position inside a rectangular bounding box during the time window (default the last 2 hours, at most 4 hours). The latitude span plus the longitude span may not exceed 4 degrees.

timeFrom.description: Start of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to 2 hours ago. The window may not exceed 4 hours.

timeTo.description: End of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to now. The window may not exceed 4 hours.

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: timeFrom
parameters.description: Start of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to 2 hours ago. The window may not exceed 4 hours.

parameters.name: timeTo
parameters.description: End of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to now. The window may not exceed 4 hours.

tool_signatures.name: get_vessels_in_radius
tool_signatures.description: Find vessels with an AIS position within a radius of a point during the time window (default the last 2 hours, at most 4 hours). The radius is in METRES, not nautical miles or kilometres.

radius.description: Search radius in METRES, maximum 100000 (100 km). One nautical mile is 1852 metres.

timeFrom.description: Start of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to 2 hours ago. The window may not exceed 4 hours.

timeTo.description: End of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to now. The window may not exceed 4 hours.

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in METRES, maximum 100000 (100 km). One nautical mile is 1852 metres.

parameters.name: timeFrom
parameters.description: Start of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to 2 hours ago. The window may not exceed 4 hours.

parameters.name: timeTo
parameters.description: End of the time window, RFC3339. Defaults to now. The window may not exceed 4 hours.
